description: Requires both a new WinUI application and a concrete port of an existing WPF screen.
prompt: Create a separate WinUI 3 app for Tidewell Intake and port this WPF form into it, including its binding and submit handler. The branch offices still need the old client unchanged.

paraphrases.novice: Can you start a WinUI 3 version of Tidewell Intake and move this form over so entering and submitting a reference still works? People are using the WPF version, so we need to keep it intact.
paraphrases.terse: Tidewell: new WinUI 3 project + port WPF intake form. Keep old client working.
